charge sheet came to be filed and case is pending in C.C.No.75/2020 against these petitioners and another, on the file of IV Additional Civil Judge and JMFC., Ballari, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 354, 354(A), 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC.
Petitioners have sought for quashing of the said proceedings.
During pendency of the petition, petitioner No.3/accused No.4 died, therefore, the petition by her does not survive for consideration.

sentences.text: An application is filed under Section 320 read with Section 482 of the Criminal Procedure Code (hereinafter referred to as the "Cr.P.C.", for brevity) seeking permission to compound the offences.
The said application is supported by verifying affidavits of the petitioner No.2 and respondent No.2.
The petitioner No.2 and respondent No.2 are physically present.
The respondent No.2 represented by Kum. Ranjita G. Alagawadi, learned counsel.

The matter between NC: 2023:KHC-D:13334 petitioners and respondent No.2 has been amicably settled on following terms and conditions which are enumerated in para 2 of the application:
a) In view of settlement between the parties the Respondent No. 2/complainant agreed to withdraw all the allegations made by her in the case on hand and she had no objection for quashing of the impugned proceedings.
b) Accused No. 1 husband filed O.S. No. 13/2019 on the file of Family Court, Ballari for dissolution of marriage and Respondent No. 2 complainant has no objection for decreeing the said suit by granting decree of divorce.
c) Further, Accused No. 1 husband filed G & WC No. 7/2019 on the file of Family Court, Ballari for custody of children and in terms of settlement elder daughter Mehak Ali should be in the custody of the accused and younger daughter Saniya Ali in the custody of the Respondent No. 2/complainant.
d) The Respondent No. 2 complainant further agreed not to claim any alimony (maintenance) from the Accused No. 1 towards her and her child Saniya Ali and further she has agreed not to claim any property to her and her daughter as she is well off.
e) In terms of compromise, both the parties undertake that they will not interfere with each other life and they will not claim any property against each other.

Further,
they NC: 2023:KHC-D:13334 have agreed not to file any case against each other or against their family in future.
They are also at liberty to lead their own life without interference of each other.

f) Respondent No. 2 has no objection to quash the impugned proceedings in C.C. No.
75/2020 pending on the file of Court of IV Addl. Civil Judge & J.M.F.C., Ballari,
registered for the alleged offences punishable under Section 498A, 354, 354(A), 323,
504 & 506 R/W 34 of IPC against all the petitioners.
